title: Timecard Calculation Methodology
overview: Timecard calculations sum work hours across multiple days for payroll purposes. Proper rounding rules and overtime calculations are essential for compliance.

methods.name: Weekly Timecard Totals
methods.description: Sum daily hours for weekly totals, applying overtime rules as appropriate.

formula.name: Weekly Hours
formula.expression:
Weekly Total = Σ(Daily Hours)
Regular = min(Weekly Total, 40)
Overtime = max(0, Weekly Total - 40)

methods.name: Time Rounding (7-Minute Rule)
methods.description: FLSA allows rounding to nearest quarter hour. The 7-minute rule rounds down 1-7 minutes, up 8-14 minutes.

formula.name: Quarter-Hour Rounding
formula.expression:
1-7 minutes → round down
8-14 minutes → round up to 15
16-22 minutes → round down to 15
23-29 minutes → round up to 30
formula.description: Must average out fairly over time

footnotes: Employers must keep time records for 3 years
Meal breaks (30+ min) typically unpaid, rest breaks (< 20 min) typically paid
Some states require paid sick leave tracking
